pipeline.title: Situation
pipeline.detail: Pre-ball state for 192,412 legal balls; par model (test MAE 18 runs) and logistic WP model (test AUC 0.80, Brier 0.184).
pipeline.output: Win probability, WPA and leverage per ball

pipeline.title: Stakes
pipeline.detail: Knockout x1.4, must-win x1.15, series decider x1.25, dead rubber x0.85, IPL NRR race x1.2.

pipeline.title: Opponent threat
pipeline.detail: Leave-one-out tiers per phase (Elite top 15%, Strong next 25%). Batter facing Elite x1.43; bowler facing Elite x2.0.

pipeline.title: Performance vs expected
pipeline.detail: Top 20% of balls by leverage x stakes x threat; runs, wickets (worth 7.6 runs) and WPA vs the state's expectation.

pipeline.title: Shrink & rank
pipeline.detail: Empirical-Bayes shrinkage, eligibility, 1,000 bootstrap resamples by match.

limitations.title: Small pressure samples
limitations.detail: Even eligible players have 120-650 pressure balls; bootstrap rank intervals are wide, so read P(top 10) alongside the rank.

limitations.title: First-innings win probability is uncertain
limitations.detail: Without a target the WP model is weaker in innings 1 (test AUC 0.68) than in the chase.

limitations.title: Early wickets carry real leverage
limitations.detail: In this data an early wicket moves win probability as much as many death-over balls, so powerplay balls are often pressure balls. The rule-based sensitivity test shows how rankings change without this.

limitations.title: Tiers use the full period
limitations.detail: Threat tiers are descriptive and built on all seasons, so an opponent's tier reflects the whole 2022-2026 window, not form on the day.

limitations.title: Mixed competition strength
limitations.detail: International matches include associate and A-team sides. Opposition Elo down-weights weaker opponents but cannot remove the difference.

limitations.title: No fielding, venue or ball-tracking data
limitations.detail: Fielding, pitch and venue effects are only partly absorbed by state expectations; bowl_speed was dropped (about 39% zeros).

rules.bat: batters: 84 eligible of 888 with any balls (>= 150 pressure balls and >= 15 matches with pressure balls); 84 pass the ball rule, 133 the match rule
rules.bowl: bowlers: 97 eligible of 647 with any balls (>= 120 pressure balls and >= 15 matches with pressure balls); 98 pass the ball rule, 133 the match rule
